1. **Principal Staff Rigor:** Reality grounding (verify existing code first), clean architecture, and defensive design.

4. **Zero Babysitting & Zero Bloat:** Deliver Production-Ready, verified code with high-signal conciseness.
5. **Strict Project Grounding & Zero Irrelevant Drift (Loyiha Butunligi):** Never generate code, files, or fictional dependencies unrelated to this project's real architecture and requested scope. Zero generic filler, zero out-of-scope drift.
